description: PRESENTER step 0 — call this BEFORE record_burn. Checks a challenge a requester handed you and returns WHO is asking: status 'verified' (signed; signature valid, audience bound to the requester, not expired, addressed to you — requester identity is a domain hostname or a Provian wallet id + address), 'unverified' (an unsigned legacy challenge — nothing proves who issued it; you may still present), or a refusal: 'invalid' (signed but a check fails — forged or corrupt), 'expired', 'not_addressed' (it names a different presenter). may_present is false for the refusals: do not burn. Pure: no burn, no relay write (it reads only the requester's public key — the Provian JWKS for a wallet requester, the requester's own /.well-known/provian-requester.json for a domain, fetched https-only). No credentials needed.

challenge_envelope.description: The requester's challenge envelope, verbatim (object or JSON string): {v, audience, challenge, predicates?, issuedAt, expiresAt, presenter?, requester, sig}.

predicates.description: Legacy challenge: its predicates, if any.

presenter_address.description: Your 0x address, to check a challenge addressed to one presenter. Local stdio defaults to this machine's identity.

name: check_challenge
